notes: Part 3 of 3 of the IMD6900 Frens on-chain art. Deploy FrenArtChunk5, FrenArtChunk6 and FrenArtChunk7 from src/FrenArtChunks.sol unchanged, with no constructor arguments, then FrenRenderer from src/FrenRenderer.sol. The renderer receives FrenArtChunk1 and FrenArtChunk2 from IMD launch #819, FrenArtChunk3 and FrenArtChunk4 from #838, and the three newly deployed chunks, in chunk order 1 through 7. FrenRenderer checks each chunk's code hash against FrenArtIndex. The chunks contain generated art data after a STOP byte; FrenArtChunk7 frames the data with a PUSH32 byte before each 32 bytes. These contracts have no owner and require no configuration, ETH funding or initialization calls.
